_metadata.description: Requirements for FixClass metadata, honest autofix output, parse-not-grep config checks, and suppression governance.

requirements.title: Declare one fix class per rule
requirements.description: Each static-quality rule declares whether it is autofix-capable or detection-only, and contract output derives from that metadata.

validation.notes: [REQ:QH-FIX-001] Every rule declares metadata, fix class, evaluator, and matching fixer coverage for autofix-class rules.
[REQ:QH-FIX-001] Surface and scenario applicability derive from the rule registry.

requirements.title: Report only honest autofix availability
requirements.description: `autofix_available` is derived from the rule fix class and fixer capability, and is false when a fixer cannot preview a safe change.

validation.notes: [REQ:QH-FIX-003] Missing tsconfig findings do not expose a fake repair command.

requirements.title: Round-trip every autofix-class config rule
requirements.description: Each autofix-class static-quality rule can preview and apply a safe config repair for a representative broken fixture.

validation.notes: [REQ:QH-FIX-002] TS config, ESLint safety/typed config, package build typecheck, Test Genie lint strictness, go.mod, golangci required linters, and Makefile gates preview and apply successfully.
[REQ:QH-FIX-002] Missing golangci config previews and applies as the GO_LINT_CONFIG_PRESENT fixer.

requirements.title: Surface aggregate autofixability
requirements.description: JSON, CLI human output, and Test Genie quality output expose the autofixable count and a repair command when any finding is fixable.

validation.notes: [REQ:QH-FIX-004] Test Genie parses Quality Health JSON and preserves next-step observations; validate with `cd scenarios/test-genie/api && GOWORK=off go test ./internal/orchestrator/phases -run Quality`.

requirements.title: Govern suppression patterns
requirements.description: Bare suppressions are findings; suppressions with written reasons are allowed so legitimate local exceptions stay explicit.

validation.notes: [REQ:QH-SUP-001] Bare Go nolint directives are warning findings.
[REQ:QH-SUP-001] Reasoned Go nolint directives are allowed.
[REQ:QH-SUP-001] Bare TypeScript suppressions are warning findings.

requirements.title: Reject disabled or commented config evidence
requirements.description: Config checks parse the effective config shape so disabled or commented entries do not satisfy quality contracts.

validation.notes: [REQ:QH-AUDIT-006] A disabled golangci linter still fails.
[REQ:QH-AUDIT-006] Commented Makefile targets do not satisfy the gate.
[REQ:QH-AUDIT-006] Commented ESLint typed config does not satisfy the gate.
